analysis: The only changed file in this batch is landing/src/app/globals.css, a marketing-site stylesheet. The visible patch removes the .story-section-heading rule (base lines 1574-1582) and reworks the .closing, .closing-content and .closing-copy layout, switching from absolute positioning to a grid/flex flow layout. Other changed ranges fall past the supplied excerpts (base ~4023-4321 and 5983-5985), so those hunks were not visible. The visible hunks are layout-only, with no JavaScript, network, authentication, key, attestation or cache logic. No threat-model assets (A-001 through A-017), boundaries (TB-002, TB-003, TB-007, TB-009, TB-010, TB-011) or threats in the supplied index are affected by what I could see. T-041 was supplied as a relevant definition but concerns provider prefix-cache code in provider-swift, which this batch does not touch. The patch excerpt is marked incomplete, so a later pass should check the remaining CSS hunks for anything unusual. Examples would be external url() references or content-injection tricks, though nothing suggests that. The CSS references only local /fonts and /logo.svg. A mild coverage limit is that the other files in the PR, such as the HTML/TSX components that the CSS classes style, are not in this batch.
